cases.title: Esc at the pit label question with linking.pitLabelOnEsc OFF (default) leaves no label and no usual-spot line
cases.plan_item: UX-CPLAN-22 learned office spot (pit label on Esc), switch linking.pitLabelOnEsc
cases.reviewed_against: builder-filled: Opus review still needed. Written 30 Oct 2026 from the J4 brief (source read by the desk at 5888ee75: Modules/Drainage/Rules/PitLabelOnEscRule.cs). Not compared with the 3.0.87 source.
cases.expected: Same steps with the switch at its default OFF: exactly one new pit, no PIT LABEL block, no "usual spot" line; one U removes the pit.
cases.why_not_unit: The label and the Esc answer exist only at the live PIT prompts.
not_automated: The label's corner and its distance from the pit edge are not measured (a Codex look judges the picture).
